queries.query: Santa Maria RS Brazil official cadastral parcel map geoportal cadastro mapa lots municipality
queries.result: Found the official municipal GEO Santa Maria description, which states that the system provides cadastral/georeferenced information for the urban 1st District-Sede and some district seats, including neighborhoods, blocks, lots, cadastral/property information, buildings, and spatial tools. The current official GeoMais endpoint was then tested anonymously.

queries.query: Santa Maria RS cadastro imobiliário mapa lotes GEO Santa Maria prefeitura oficial
queries.result: The official Secretaria de Município de Urbanismo e Projetos page confirms GEO Santa Maria as the municipal GIS and describes cadastral lots, blocks, streets, property records, buildings, and public informational use. The official public entry point currently returned HTTP 401 to anonymous requests.

registry.custodian: Prefeitura Municipal de Santa Maria, Secretaria de Município de Urbanismo e Projetos / Instituto de Planejamento de Santa Maria (municipal GEO Santa Maria cadastral GIS)
